chapters.reason: The paper introduces Recursive Transformers that explicitly share parameters across layers by repeating a single block in a loop, which is an architectural modification for recurrence, aligning with the definition of Architectural Recurrence.

The paper discusses converting existing LLMs into Recursive Transformers with minimal performance loss, which involves training strategies to adapt the shared-parameter architecture, though it is not the primary focus.
The work explores layer depth as a bottleneck by reducing unique layers via parameter sharing, indirectly relating to how depth influences reasoning capacity, though not the main contribution.
